title: Nebulus Explore Men's Fleece Jacket — with Full-Length Zip, Navy
short_description: Men's fleece jacket by Nebulus (Explore model) in navy: 100% polyester, full-length zip up to the collar, high collar.
long_description: The Nebulus Explore is a men's fleece jacket with a full-length zip in navy. According to Amazon it is made of 100% polyester (polar fleece) and is heat-retaining, water-repellent, skin-friendly and lightweight. The zip can be closed to the end of the collar and is said to protect against wind and weather. According to Amazon the fit is straight and the collar is high. An appliquéd Norway flag, logos and patches give the jacket a sporty, casual look. According to Amazon it suits hiking and other outdoor activities, especially on transitional days in spring and autumn. Before buying, please check sizes and care instructions on the Amazon product page.
